title: Truck Quantities, Weights & Prices: Numbers & Quantifiers
description: Accurately communicate payload capacities in metric tons, pricing per chassis unit, and order quantities in tenders.
learning_objectives: Use quantifiers: many, much, a few, several, total
State vehicle payload weights and pricing accurately in English
Avoid common Czenglish number and pluralization errors

questions.prompt: The municipal fire department ordered _____ ten tactical 4x4 tanker chassis.

explanations.correct: Standard business quantifier phrase: 'a total of ten chassis'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'celkem deset podvozků'. Standard commercial English idiom: 'a total of ten...'.

questions.prompt: How _____ payload weight can the 8x8 heavy recovery vehicle carry off-road?
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Kolik váhy / nosnosti...?'. Uncountable nouns take 'How much weight'.

questions.prompt: We have _____ spare military wheel rims in stock at the central warehouse.

explanations.correct: Plural countable noun 'wheel rims' takes 'several' in affirmative clauses.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Máme několik náhradních disků'. Countable plural takes 'several'.

questions.prompt: The total contract value exceeds €2.5 _____ Euros for the complete fleet package.

explanations.correct: When preceded by an exact number or decimal, 'million' does not take plural -s: '€2.5 million'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'millions of' is only used without exact numbers.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech '2,5 milionu eur'. After numerals, never pluralize: '2.5 million Euros', NOT *2.5 millions*.

questions.prompt: There are only _____ slots remaining in our Q3 assembly schedule for international orders.

explanations.correct: Countable plural noun 'slots' takes 'a few' (small positive quantity).

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'zbývá jen několik volných termínů'. Countable plural takes 'a few slots'.

questions.prompt: The gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR) of this heavy dump truck is 38 _____ tons.

explanations.correct: The adjective for metric units is 'metric': '38 metric tons'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech '38 tun'. The standard technical phrase in international sales is 'metric tons'.

questions.prompt: How _____ trucks does the municipal forestry department plan to order this year?

explanations.wrong_B: 'many of' is redundant before bare noun.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Kolik nákladních vozidel...?'. Countable plural takes 'How many trucks'.

questions.prompt: The distributor paid an initial deposit of 20 _____ upon signing the sales contract.

explanations.correct: After a number, 'percent' never takes plural -s: '20 percent'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech '20 procent'. After numerals, never say *percents*. Always say '20 percent'.

questions.prompt: We received _____ inquiries from defense contractors in Southeast Asia this month.
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'četné / mnoho poptávek'. Plural countable takes 'numerous inquiries'.

questions.prompt: The base chassis price is €185,000, and customized armor plating _____ extra.

explanations.correct: Singular abstract/uncountable subject 'armor plating' takes 'costs' with 3rd person -s.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'pancéřování stojí navíc'. Singular subject takes '-s': 'costs extra'.
